_doc: HTML pages. ref_cmd.include: the attributes that name a file (src, href, a form action, an object data, a lazy data-src); path_sub.include: a URL (scheme:, //host), a fragment (#top) and a mail link name nothing of ours, a query or fragment is cut, a root-relative /img/a.png is looked up as a path suffix. ref_cmd.scan: an on* attribute is script text, its calls are uses; scan_value: so is an href (src, action) that starts with javascript:. embed: the <script> blocks that hold code (no src, type module / text/javascript / absent) are extracted as JavaScript; their top-level functions are globals that the page calls by name from attributes and other scripts (soft script roots).
